description: The bar chart illustrates the average performance of five different methods—Standard, Self-RAG, FactTune, CInGS (w/), and CInGS—on a task evaluated by a metric labeled “Average Performance,” which ranges from 0 to 60 on the vertical axis. The horizontal axis lists the five methods in that order, each represented by a distinct colored bar: orange for Standard (~53), light brown for Self-RAG (~54), green for FactTune (~52), blue for CInGS (w/) (~54), and dark blue for CInGS (~59). The bars are of similar width and evenly spaced, with no error bars or additional annotations. The chart visually emphasizes that CInGS achieves the highest performance, notably surpassing the other methods by approximately 5 points, while the remaining four methods cluster closely between 52 and 54. The y-axis is linear with major gridlines at intervals of 10, and the chart title or context is implied by the paper name “Context-Informed Grounding Supervision,” suggesting the methods relate to grounding or retrieval-augmented generation tasks.
